dataset_sources.license: annotations CC BY 4.0; selected image metadata CC BY 2.0

limitations: Small source-grouped subset; not an official benchmark score
Houseplant labels are broader than potted tabletop plants; domain validation required

excluded_samples.reason: Right-edge foliage has unresolved rooted/potted status; image-level empty label is unreliable.

threshold_selection_scope: Use validation only for threshold selection; test curves are diagnostic, not tuning data
timing_scope: PC PyTorch prediction only; first sample includes cold initialization; excludes TCP, stereo and Unity animation
preprocessing: YOLO predict: minimal stride-aligned rectangular letterbox
native_validation_comparability: Ultralytics val may add 0.5 stride padding and produce different tensor shapes at the same imgsz; use this runtime-shaped report for the service gate
